issues.title: The decision that is final and reviewable by nobody
issues.category_name: Gatekeeping: the person who can say no, and does
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Decides a case with no obligation to explain or be reviewed
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: The defining structure of gatekeeping abuse: one official, one decision, no appeal, no written reasons, and a record that follows you. Everything else in this category is a variation on it.

details.aspect: The structural fact
details.description: At a port of entry the officer's determination is final and no appeal process exists. That single sentence is what converts a procedure into a power relationship.
details.energy_note: Decided in minutes, by one person, forever.

details.aspect: No reasons means nothing to argue with
details.description: Where reasons are not given, or are given as a category rather than a finding, there is no proposition to rebut. The applicant cannot demonstrate the decision was wrong because nothing was asserted.
details.energy_note: You cannot disprove a sentence nobody wrote.

details.aspect: The refusal outlives the refusal
details.description: A denial is not a formal inadmissibility but it remains in the system, and every later official sees it. One person's judgement on one morning becomes a permanent property of the file.
details.energy_note: A bad morning, attached to you permanently.

details.aspect: So the rational move is to withdraw rather than be refused
details.description: Practitioners advise that withdrawing the application and departing is generally preferable to accepting a formal refusal. The applicant is choosing to lose in order to avoid losing on the record - which is a decision made under duress and recorded as voluntary.
details.energy_note: Volunteering to fail, so the failure is not written down.

details.aspect: It selects for the compliant
details.description: When the decision-maker is unreviewable, the applicant who questions, corrects or objects is taking a risk the compliant applicant is not. Over time the process trains everyone who passes through it, and the training is the point.
details.energy_note: Everyone learns to be agreeable, and calls it preparation.

issues.title: Your job does not exist on their list
issues.category_name: Gatekeeping: the person who can say no, and does
issues.target_note: A migrant, visa applicant or non-citizen
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls access to a thing the target needs
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: The TN occupation list was fixed in the 1994 NAFTA appendix and has not moved. 'Data Scientist' is not on it. The applicant is refused not because they are unqualified but because the list is thirty years old, and the officer is not permitted to notice that.

details.aspect: EXAMPLE - the category that was never written
details.description: 'Data Scientist' does not appear on the TN professions list. Its duties could potentially qualify under Mathematician or Computer Systems Analyst, but the mapping is not automatic: a data scientist does not qualify as a Computer Systems Analyst unless the role emphasises systems analysis over model development.
details.energy_note: A job that did not exist when the list was written.

details.aspect: Officers apply categories, not equivalence
details.description: Officers trained under CBP field guidance apply strict categorical definitions rather than functional equivalence. If duties span several categories or align cleanly with none, the application faces heightened scrutiny - so being genuinely interdisciplinary is a liability.
details.energy_note: Penalised for having a modern job.

details.aspect: EXAMPLE - refused in minutes over a job title
details.description: Denials have involved applicants with relevant degrees and years of experience rejected within minutes because the employer letter used generic internal job titles rather than the language of the statutory category.
details.energy_note: A career, assessed against a word in a letter.

details.aspect: EXAMPLE - the same person, refused and then approved
details.description: An applicant was denied by CBP under the Mathematician/Statistician category because the officer did not think the job qualified. On refiling - transcripts highlighting statistics and maths coursework, post-doctoral data science training, published research, and authority that a statistics degree is not required for a statistician post - it was approved the same day at Buffalo. Same facts. Different officer.
details.energy_note: Refused and approved on identical facts, by two people.
details.notes: The single clearest demonstration in this dataset that the variable being measured is the officer, not the applicant.

details.aspect: The burden is to pre-write the officer's reasoning
details.description: The practitioner advice is to cross-reference the position against the category definition word-for-word and reframe the role in statutory language. The applicant must therefore anticipate and script the decision-maker's analysis - unpaid legal work, done in advance, by the person with least power.
details.money_note: Legal fees to have the letter written correctly.
details.energy_note: Writing the officer's reasoning for him, at your own expense.

details.aspect: Aggregate effect: a profession locked out by a 1994 appendix
details.description: TN RFE rates have run around 31%, the commonest deficiency being insufficient evidence that the position qualifies. An entire modern occupation is excluded not by policy decision but by the list never having been updated - and nobody is accountable for a list.
details.energy_note: Excluded by an appendix nobody has amended since 1994.

issues.title: Any defect will do
issues.category_name: Gatekeeping: the person who can say no, and does
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Decides a case with no obligation to explain or be reviewed
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Where the decision is already made, the stated ground is selected afterwards from whatever is available: the transcript, the date format, the missing stamp, the phrasing of a letter. The pretext is real, which is what makes it unanswerable.

details.aspect: The defect is genuine and is not the reason
details.description: Every substantial application contains something that can be called deficient. Selecting one and citing it produces a refusal that is literally accurate and substantively false.
details.energy_note: True on its face, and not why.

details.aspect: It cannot be distinguished from good-faith rigour
details.description: An officer applying the same scrutiny to everyone and an officer looking for a reason produce identical paperwork. The target has no way to tell which happened, and neither does any reviewer.
details.energy_note: Indistinguishable from somebody just being careful.

details.aspect: Fixing it produces a new defect
details.description: The applicant corrects the transcript issue and is then asked about the employer letter; corrects that and is asked about the itinerary. The supply of available defects is not exhausted by curing them.
details.energy_note: Every fix reveals the next objection.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the third submission
details.description: First time: the degree certificate was not notarised. Second time: the notarisation was more than six months old. Third time: the employer letter did not specify the supervision structure. Each objection is correct. None was mentioned when it could have been raised together.
details.energy_note: Three refusals, three true reasons, one decision.

details.aspect: The target learns to over-document everything, forever
details.description: The permanent adaptation is anticipatory excess: notarising what does not need notarising, explaining what was not asked. It is expensive, it reads as anxious, and it is entirely rational.
details.energy_note: Over-preparing for the rest of your life.

issues.title: Compliance with the tone as a condition of the outcome
issues.category_name: Gatekeeping: the person who can say no, and does
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Decides a case with no obligation to explain or be reviewed
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: The brief names this precisely: being refused for not complying with abusive language. The official is rude; the applicant's reaction to the rudeness becomes evidence; the evidence justifies the refusal. Nothing in the file records that the officer went first.

details.aspect: The demand is for demeanour, not for information
details.description: The questions stop being about eligibility and start being about deference. Answering correctly but without sufficient deference is treated as a problem with the applicant.
details.energy_note: Assessed on manner, recorded as substance.

details.aspect: Objecting is the offence
details.description: Pointing out that a question is improper, or that the tone is hostile, converts the applicant into someone who was difficult - which is a permissible ground where the decision is discretionary and unreviewable.
details.energy_note: Naming it is what you are punished for.

details.aspect: Which makes the abuse self-concealing
details.description: The only people who generate a record of the behaviour are the people who reacted to it, and reacting is what gets recorded as the fault. The compliant leave no evidence and the non-compliant's evidence is about them.
details.energy_note: The record only ever contains the target's reaction.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the question about her husband
details.description: The officer asks why a woman of her age is travelling alone and whether her husband approves. She says the question is not relevant to the application. The refusal notes that she was uncooperative during questioning and that her answers regarding the purpose of travel were inconsistent.
details.energy_note: Declining an improper question, recorded as inconsistency.

details.aspect: It teaches a lesson that generalises
details.description: Anyone who has been refused this way approaches every subsequent official - a doctor, a landlord, a police officer - having learned that objecting to mistreatment is materially expensive. The training transfers.
details.energy_note: Learning, permanently, that objecting costs you.

issues.title: The question you are not allowed to be unable to answer
issues.category_name: Gatekeeping: the person who can say no, and does
issues.target_note: A migrant, visa applicant or non-citizen
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls access to a thing the target needs
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Who is the end client. What is their address. Who supervises you day to day. Questions that are reasonable for the officer to ask and frequently impossible for the applicant to answer, because the answer is commercially confidential, not yet decided, or not theirs to give.

details.aspect: The information belongs to somebody else
details.description: A contractor placed through an agency frequently does not know the end client's legal name, address or supervision structure, and the agency may be contractually barred from disclosing it. Not knowing is a correct professional answer and reads as evasion.
details.energy_note: The honest answer is 'I am not allowed to know that'.

details.aspect: Third-party placement is treated as a red flag in itself
details.description: Signals of scrutiny include a role appearing too junior for professional level and below-market compensation - both of which are ordinary features of agency contracting rather than evidence of anything.
details.energy_note: Normal employment structures, read as suspicious.

details.aspect: The applicant cannot prepare because the question is not published
details.description: There is no list of what will be asked. The applicant learns what the questions are by failing to answer them.
details.energy_note: An exam whose syllabus is the transcript of your refusal.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the consultancy
details.description: He is employed by a firm in Toronto, billed to a client he has signed an NDA about, working on a project that has not been publicly announced. The officer asks where he will physically sit on Monday. He does not know; the allocation happens in the first week. The refusal cites inability to describe the position.
details.energy_note: Refused for not knowing something that is not yet true.

issues.title: The document that is correct and not accepted
issues.category_name: Gatekeeping: the person who can say no, and does
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls access to a thing the target needs
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: The transcript, the certificate, the translation, the stamp. Genuine, sufficient, and rejected on a formal ground that could have been stated at the outset and was not.

details.aspect: Requirements that are discovered rather than published
details.description: Notarisation age, translator accreditation, seal type, whether a digital transcript counts. These are rarely stated in advance and are applied as though they were obvious.
details.energy_note: A rule you were required to know and nobody published.

details.aspect: Each cure has a fee and a wait
details.description: Reissuing, retranslating, re-notarising. The cost lands entirely on the applicant, and the institution that failed to state the requirement bears none of it.
details.energy_note: Paying to satisfy a rule you were told about afterwards.

details.aspect: It is worse where the issuing institution is damaged
details.description: Where a university, registry or ministry cannot answer a verification request, the absence is attributed to the applicant as suspected fraud rather than to the institution as a records problem.
details.energy_note: An archive failure, read as a lie about yourself.
details.notes: Connects to DOC and EDU categories in assets/text/{nigeria,palestine,iran}.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the apostille
details.description: Her degree is genuine. The evaluator needs an apostille. Her country is not party to the convention. The evaluator's form has no box for that, so the file is marked incomplete, and there is nobody whose job it is to resolve a category error.
details.energy_note: Incomplete, permanently, because of a treaty she is not party to.

issues.title: Same file, different officer, opposite outcome
issues.category_name: Gatekeeping: the person who can say no, and does
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Decides a case with no obligation to explain or be reviewed
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: The clearest evidence that the variable is not the applicant. Two decisions on identical facts, days apart, in opposite directions - and no mechanism anywhere treats that as a problem.

details.aspect: It is documented and it is not treated as an error
details.description: The TN statistician case in GAT-002 is one instance: refused, then approved on refiling with the same underlying facts. Inconsistency of this kind is not recorded as a defect in the system; it is absorbed as the ordinary operation of discretion.
details.energy_note: Two opposite correct decisions, and no contradiction anywhere.

details.aspect: Which converts the process into a lottery with an entry fee
details.description: If the outcome varies with the decision-maker, then reapplying is rational, and reapplying costs money. The system extracts a fee per attempt at a randomised outcome.
details.energy_note: Paying again for a different roll.

details.aspect: Only the well-advised know to try again
details.description: The applicant with a lawyer is told a refusal is not the end. The applicant without one believes an official decision means something. The variance therefore sorts by access to advice.
details.energy_note: The refusal is final for the people who believe it is.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the two sisters at two windows
details.description: Same sponsor, same documents, same purpose, same day, adjacent counters. One is issued and one is refused for insufficient ties. There is no forum in which those two decisions can be placed side by side.
details.energy_note: Nowhere on earth can those two files be compared.

issues.title: The queue as the instrument
issues.category_name: Gatekeeping: the person who can say no, and does
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls access to a thing the target needs
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: No refusal is issued. The application is simply not decided - past the appointment, past the start date, past the point at which the thing it was for still exists.

details.aspect: Silence is not a decision and cannot be appealed
details.description: Appeal rights attach to determinations. Where nothing is determined, there is nothing to appeal, and the outcome is identical to refusal.
details.energy_note: Refused in effect, and never refused on paper.

details.aspect: It is cheaper for the institution than refusing
details.description: A refusal generates a file, a possible challenge and a statistic. Non-decision generates none of those, and produces the same result.
details.energy_note: The cheapest way to say no is to say nothing.

details.aspect: The target must keep everything alive while waiting
details.description: Job offers, course places, tenancies, medical appointments and the goodwill of whoever is sponsoring - all maintained indefinitely against a date nobody will give.
details.energy_note: Holding a life open for a date nobody will name.

details.aspect: Attrition is the mechanism
details.description: A process slow enough causes a predictable share of applicants to give up, which is cheaper than deciding. Withdrawal is then recorded as the applicant's choice.
details.energy_note: Designed so that you stop asking.
details.notes: Same structure as ADM-004 in assets/text/general and the non-response rows in assets/text/palestine.

issues.title: Babe, sweetheart, dear, from somebody with power
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: The brief's own example. A man in a position of power calling women customers 'babe'. Individually trivial, universally understood, and constructed so that objecting makes the objector the problem.

details.aspect: What it actually does
details.description: It reassigns the relationship. A customer, a colleague or a patient becomes someone junior, familiar and slightly comic. It is done in one word and takes no time at all.
details.energy_note: Demoted, in a single syllable.

details.aspect: It has a name and a literature
details.description: This is benevolent sexism in Glick and Fiske's sense: subjectively positive attitudes toward women in traditional roles, built on protective paternalism - viewing women as not fully competent adults - and serving the same hierarchy as the hostile form.
details.energy_note: Warm, well-meant, and doing exactly the same work as contempt.
details.notes: Glick & Fiske, Ambivalent Sexism Inventory, JPSP 1996.

details.aspect: The asymmetry is the whole of it
details.description: He calls her babe. She cannot call him babe. If the term were genuinely friendly it would be reciprocal, and it never is - which is how the target knows what it is, and cannot prove it.
details.energy_note: Try saying it back and watch what happens.

details.aspect: Objecting costs more than absorbing
details.description: In front of colleagues or other customers, the objection is the disruptive event. The person who said it becomes the reasonable party and the person who objected becomes difficult, humourless or aggressive.
details.energy_note: Whoever mentions it is the one who caused a scene.

details.aspect: Repetition changes its category
details.description: Sue's point is that a remark can be a microinsult the first time and a microassault by the third, because by then the speaker has been told. Intent stops being available as a defence and continues to be used as one.
details.energy_note: The first time it is careless. The fourth time it is a decision.

details.aspect: It is the audible part of an inaudible pattern
details.description: The same person who says babe also interrupts, explains her own field to her, and addresses the man beside her when answering her question. The word is reportable and trivial; the pattern is serious and unreportable.
details.energy_note: The only bit you can point at is the bit that sounds smallest.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the service counter
details.description: Fourth visit about the same billing error. 'Alright babe, let's have a look.' He is friendly. He fixes it. She has been coming back for three weeks and has been called babe by him each time, and if she says anything the friendliness will stop and the billing error will take longer.
details.energy_note: The helpfulness is conditional and both of them know it.

issues.title: First names one way, titles the other
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: He is Doctor. She is Sarah. The asymmetry is never announced and is maintained by everyone in the room.

details.aspect: Same qualification, different address
details.description: Documented repeatedly in clinical and academic settings: the man is introduced by title and the woman by first name, by the same speaker, in the same sentence.
details.energy_note: Introduced into a lower rank than you hold.

details.aspect: Correcting it is a bigger act than committing it
details.description: Saying 'it's Doctor' costs the speaker nothing and costs the corrector a reputation for standing on ceremony.
details.energy_note: Insisting on your own title is the rude part.

details.aspect: It is a microinsult in the technical sense
details.description: A communication conveying disrespect through a hidden message, frequently unintentional - which is what makes the pattern durable: nobody in the chain has to intend it for it to work every time.
details.energy_note: Nobody meant it, and it happened anyway.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the panel
details.description: Four speakers. The chair introduces Professor Adeyemi, Professor Lindqvist, Doctor Hassan, and 'and Maria, who's going to talk to us about the data'. Maria has the same doctorate as the other three.
details.energy_note: Three titles and a first name.

issues.title: Getting your name wrong for years
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Persistent mispronunciation, casual shortening, or the substitution of an easier name entirely - performed by people who manage unfamiliar words in every other part of their work.

details.aspect: The effort is selective
details.description: The same colleague who cannot manage Oluwaseun handles Tchaikovsky and Worcestershire. The difficulty is not phonological.
details.energy_note: Impossible to say, for you specifically.

details.aspect: Being renamed for somebody else's convenience
details.description: Shortening without being asked - assigning a nickname because the real one is 'just so different' - is documented as a standard workplace microinsult, and it is done to the person rather than agreed with them.
details.energy_note: Given a new name by a stranger, for their benefit.

details.aspect: Correcting has a budget and it runs out
details.description: The first three corrections are fine. The tenth makes you the person who keeps bringing it up. Most people stop correcting and answer to the wrong name for years.
details.energy_note: Answering to something that is not your name.

details.aspect: It produces the document mismatches too
details.description: The shortened or misspelled version propagates into email, payroll, rotas and eventually official records, which is where a social slight becomes an administrative problem.
details.energy_note: A nickname somebody invented, now on your payslip.
details.notes: Feeds the NAM categories in assets/text/{nigeria,palestine,iran}.

issues.title: Being explained to, slowly
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Volume, pace and vocabulary adjusted downward on the basis of accent, gender, age or appearance rather than anything the person has said.

details.aspect: The adjustment happens before you speak
details.description: It is triggered by appearance or a name on a screen, which is how the target knows it is not about comprehension.
details.energy_note: Decided before you opened your mouth.

details.aspect: Your own field, explained to you
details.description: Being told how your specialism works by somebody outside it, in simplified terms, in front of people who know you are the specialist.
details.energy_note: Lectured on the thing you are the expert in.

details.aspect: Objecting sounds like arrogance
details.description: Saying 'I know, I wrote the protocol' is accurate and lands as boasting. Absorbing it costs credibility with everyone watching.
details.energy_note: Correct and insufferable, or silent and diminished.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the site visit
details.description: The contractor addresses every technical answer to her junior male colleague, who relays each one back to her. This continues for two hours. Afterwards the colleague says he did not notice.
details.energy_note: Two hours of being translated to by your own junior.

issues.title: Interrupted, and then credited to someone else
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: The two-stage version: the point is cut off when she makes it and endorsed when a man repeats it eleven minutes later.

details.aspect: Both halves are needed
details.description: Interruption alone is rudeness. Interruption plus reattribution is a transfer of credit, and the second half is what shows up in the promotion round.
details.energy_note: Not heard, then quoted, then promoted for.

details.aspect: The room does not register it
details.description: Everyone present watched it happen and nobody experiences it as an event, which is why raising it afterwards sounds like a grievance about nothing.
details.energy_note: Twelve witnesses, no witnesses.

details.aspect: The cumulative cost is a career
details.description: Contributions that are not attributed do not appear in assessments, references or pay reviews. The mechanism is invisible per instance and decisive in aggregate.
details.money_note: Lifetime earnings effect of unattributed contribution.
details.energy_note: A career's worth of ideas, filed under other names.

details.aspect: Amplification works and requires someone else to do it
details.description: The documented remedy - a third party restating and attributing - works, and depends entirely on somebody with standing choosing to spend it. The target cannot deploy it herself.
details.energy_note: The fix exists and you cannot apply it yourself.

issues.title: Calm down
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Tone policing: the substance is set aside and the manner becomes the subject. Whatever the person was describing stops being discussed.

details.aspect: It changes the subject and appears not to
details.description: Nothing is denied. The conversation simply stops being about the thing and starts being about how the thing was raised.
details.energy_note: Not contradicted. Reclassified.

details.aspect: The instruction is unfalsifiable
details.description: Denying that you are upset is taken as evidence that you are. There is no response that exits the frame.
details.energy_note: Arguing you are calm is proof you are not.

details.aspect: It is applied unequally and that is measurable
details.description: The same volume and vocabulary from different people is read as passion or as aggression depending on who is speaking - documented across gender and race in workplace and clinical settings.
details.energy_note: Same decibels, different diagnosis.

details.aspect: It trains flatness
details.description: The adaptation is to deliver everything - including serious complaints - in a deliberately neutral register, which is exhausting and causes the complaint to be read as not serious.
details.energy_note: Flatten it enough to be heard, and it sounds unimportant.

issues.title: Complimented instead of assessed
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: The appraisal that discusses how pleasant she is to work with, and the man's that discusses what he delivered.

details.aspect: Warmth substituted for competence
details.description: Praise about manner, approachability and attitude, with no assessable claim about output - which means nothing in the review can be cited in support of promotion.
details.energy_note: Praised warmly, and unpromotably.

details.aspect: It is not criticism, so it cannot be challenged
details.description: Contesting a positive review is not a recognised act. The grievance mechanisms are built for unfair criticism and have no route for unfair praise.
details.energy_note: Too complimentary to appeal.

details.aspect: The gap surfaces years later
details.description: At the promotion round the file contains nothing measurable, and the absence is attributed to her rather than to the person who wrote six years of reviews about her being lovely.
details.energy_note: Six years of warm reviews and nothing to point at.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - two reviews, same team
details.description: His: delivered the migration, reduced incidents 40%, ready for senior. Hers: a pleasure to have on the team, always willing to help, very organised. She ran the migration.
details.energy_note: She ran it. His review says he did.

issues.title: Corrected in public, praised in private
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: The inversion of ordinary management practice, and a reliable instrument: the correction is witnessed and the credit is not.

details.aspect: The audience is the mechanism
details.description: A correction delivered in front of the team does work that the same correction in private does not: it establishes standing, publicly, at no cost to the person delivering it.
details.energy_note: The point is that everyone saw.

details.aspect: It is defensible as directness
details.description: Described afterwards as candour, high standards or not standing on ceremony - all of which are real management styles, which is what makes the pattern unprovable.
details.energy_note: Indistinguishable from somebody having high standards.

details.aspect: The private praise prevents the complaint
details.description: Because the target is also told privately that they are valued, raising the public treatment feels like ingratitude, and they usually do not.
details.energy_note: Told you are valued, exactly where nobody can hear it.

details.aspect: Leymann catalogued this in 1984
details.description: The LIPT lists constant interruption, criticism and public humiliation among 45 mobbing actions grouped under effects on self-expression and on personal reputation - derived from 300 interviews, and unchanged as a taxonomy since.
details.energy_note: Named, numbered and studied for forty years.

issues.title: The joke you are required to enjoy
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Said by someone senior, about the target or their group, with the room watching to see the reaction. Laughing endorses it; not laughing is the incident.

details.aspect: Humour is the delivery mechanism and the defence
details.description: The content is deniable because it was a joke, and the joke format obliges a response from the target in real time, in public, with no time to think.
details.energy_note: Attacked and required to smile, simultaneously.

details.aspect: Sue calls the retreat a microassault
details.description: Telling a racist or sexist joke and then saying 'I was just joking' appears in the taxonomy as a conscious, explicit discriminatory act - not an ambiguous one.
details.energy_note: The 'only joking' is part of the act, not a retraction.

details.aspect: Laughing is recorded as consent
details.description: If it is ever raised later, the fact that the target laughed at the time will be produced, and will be treated as evidence they did not mind.
details.energy_note: Your own laugh, used as a statement against you.

details.aspect: SCENARIO - the leaving drinks
details.description: The director does the accent. It is his third time and the room laughs. She laughs too, because there are eleven people watching and he approves her leave. In the taxi home she cannot work out why she feels ashamed rather than angry.
details.energy_note: Ashamed, rather than angry, and not sure why.

issues.title: You should smile more
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: An instruction about facial expression issued to strangers, colleagues and customers, almost exclusively to women, by people who would not accept the same instruction.

details.aspect: It is a demand for labour
details.description: The request is that she perform pleasantness for the comfort of the person asking, unpaid, on demand, while doing whatever she was actually doing.
details.energy_note: Asked to work harder, at looking happier.

details.aspect: It is listed as a standard microaggression
details.description: 'You should smile more' appears in the documented workplace set alongside 'you are very articulate' and 'aren't you a bit overqualified' - each carrying a message the speaker will deny.
details.energy_note: In the textbook, with the others.

details.aspect: There is no good response
details.description: Smiling complies. Not smiling confirms whatever was being alleged. Explaining is out of proportion to a four-word remark.
details.energy_note: Three responses, all of them losing.

details.aspect: It marks who is entitled to comment on whom
details.description: The information transmitted is not about her face. It is that the speaker considers her appearance a legitimate subject, and that she is expected to accept the correction.
details.energy_note: Not about smiling. About who gets to instruct.

issues.title: The secondary room
issues.category_name: Immigration, borders and the officer with no supervisor
issues.target_note: A migrant, visa applicant or non-citizen
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: The target is in their custody or care and cannot leave
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Pulled out of the queue and held, without arrest, without counsel, for as long as it takes. Nothing has been alleged and nothing has to be.

details.aspect: Rights are reduced at the border by design
details.description: At a port of entry the ordinary protections are sharply narrowed: phones can be searched without a warrant under the border search exception, and a visa holder can be returned on the next flight.
details.energy_note: Lawful, and nothing like the country you thought you were entering.

details.aspect: No clock the target can see
details.description: Inspections run from thirty minutes to many hours. Nobody states a duration, and asking how long is itself read as impatience.
details.energy_note: No end time, and asking for one counts against you.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the officer who is enjoying it
details.description: He reads her landing card, puts it down, and says nothing for forty seconds. Then: 'Sit down. I didn't say you could stand.' Every ten minutes he walks past and does not look at her. At the ninety-minute mark he returns, stamps it, and says 'See? Nothing to worry about.' Nothing improper has occurred and she will not be able to describe what did.
details.energy_note: Ninety minutes of nothing, administered deliberately.

details.aspect: The complaint route requires naming the officer
details.description: Redress mechanisms exist and require details the target was never given: a badge number they could not see, a name nobody said, a time nobody recorded.
details.energy_note: A complaints process that requires facts they withheld.

issues.title: Questions about your family, your politics and your faith
issues.category_name: Immigration, borders and the officer with no supervisor
issues.target_note: A migrant, visa applicant or non-citizen
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Decides a case with no obligation to explain or be reviewed
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Asked at a counter, with the outcome pending, by someone under no obligation to explain the relevance.

details.aspect: Relevance is never established
details.description: What your father does, which mosque you attend, who you voted for, whether you have ever been to a protest. The applicant cannot assess what a safe answer is because the criterion is not published.
details.energy_note: Answering blind, with everything riding on it.

details.aspect: Refusing to answer is an answer
details.description: Declining an irrelevant question is available in principle and converts the applicant into an uncooperative one, which is a permissible ground.
details.energy_note: The right to decline, priced at the visa.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the friendly one
details.description: He is warm throughout. 'Just between us - your brother, the one in Berlin. He's political, isn't he?' He smiles. He waits. She understands that the file is open on the screen, that the conversation is not being recorded, and that there is no version of this in which she gets to ask why he wants to know.
details.energy_note: Asked about her brother, warmly, with the file open.

details.aspect: It follows the answer home
details.description: Anything said is recorded and available to every later official, including in the country the applicant came from if information is shared.
details.energy_note: Said once at a counter, held forever.

issues.title: Being told your marriage is not real
issues.category_name: Immigration, borders and the officer with no supervisor
issues.target_note: A migrant, visa applicant or non-citizen
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Decides a case with no obligation to explain or be reviewed
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable as abuse by a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists and sometimes works
issues.summary: Interviews conducted separately, questions about bathroom habits and bedding, and a determination about a relationship made by a stranger in an afternoon.

details.aspect: The burden is to evidence intimacy
details.description: Photographs, messages, joint bills, and testimony about domestic detail. A couple who keep separate finances or are private by temperament produce a weaker file than a couple who are not.
details.energy_note: Assessed on how documentable your love is.

details.aspect: Inconsistency is treated as fabrication
details.description: Two people asked which side of the bed the other sleeps on will sometimes disagree, because people are not databases. The discrepancy is recorded as evidence of a sham.
details.energy_note: Misremembering a detail, recorded as a lie.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the separate rooms
details.description: 'Your wife says you met in March. You said February.' He lets that sit. 'One of you is lying to me. I don't mind which.' They met in late February and married in a March two years later, and he knows that, because he has both files in front of him.
details.energy_note: A contradiction manufactured out of two true answers.

details.aspect: The relationship is damaged by the process
details.description: Couples describe the interview as introducing a suspicion between them that was not there before, and the state has no mechanism that registers that as a cost.
details.energy_note: Made to doubt each other, by a procedure.

issues.title: The sponsor who owns your status
issues.category_name: Immigration, borders and the officer with no supervisor
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls money, wages, debt or housing
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable as abuse by a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Where a visa is tied to one employer, the employer acquires a power no employer should have: the ability to end the worker's right to be in the country.

details.aspect: Complaint and deportation become the same action
details.description: Raising unpaid wages, unsafe conditions or harassment risks the sponsorship, and losing the sponsorship means losing the right to remain. Every labour right becomes conditional on not using it.
details.energy_note: Every protection, void the moment you use it.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the reminder
details.description: 'You've been here fourteen months. Fourteen months is nothing, visa-wise.' He says it pleasantly, while signing something else. 'Anyway. About Saturday - I'll need you in.' It is the fourth consecutive Saturday and there is no overtime.
details.energy_note: A fact about her visa, mentioned in passing, on a Thursday.

details.aspect: It is documented as a market, not a scandal
details.description: Where permits are scarce and bound to employers, brokerage appears and is measured by central banks rather than prosecuted - the structure is treated as an economic feature.
details.energy_note: A market in permission to work, with published figures.
details.notes: See WRK-002 in assets/text/nigeria and the permit rows in assets/text/palestine.

details.aspect: Leaving costs more than staying
details.description: Changing sponsor means a new application, a gap in status, fees, and a reference from the person being left. Most people stay.
details.energy_note: The exit requires a reference from the problem.

issues.title: Administrative violence: the form as the weapon
issues.category_name: Bureaucracy: forms, delay and administrative violence
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Acts as or is shielded by an organisation
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: No individual act is abusive. The requirement is reasonable, the wait is standard, the officer is polite. The aggregate removes somebody's housing, income or medication.

details.aspect: Nobody in the chain does anything wrong
details.description: Each step is defensible in isolation. The harm exists only at the level of the whole process, and no role in the organisation is responsible for the whole process.
details.energy_note: A harm with no author anywhere in the building.

details.aspect: The burden of proof runs the wrong way
details.description: The claimant proves eligibility repeatedly; the institution never proves ineligibility. An error by the institution is remedied on the claimant's time and at the claimant's expense.
details.energy_note: Their mistake, your months.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the counter clerk who could
details.description: 'I can see the letter on my screen. But I can't accept a screenshot, I need the original.' The original was sent to an address the department corrected last month. 'Then you'll need to request a duplicate.' That takes six weeks. 'Next, please.' She could have printed it. She is not required to.
details.energy_note: Six weeks, because she did not feel like printing it.

details.aspect: Attrition is the output
details.description: A process onerous enough causes a predictable proportion to stop claiming, which is cheaper than refusing them, and appears in the statistics as reduced demand.
details.energy_note: Designed so that a percentage give up, and they do.
details.notes: Same mechanism as ADM-004 in assets/text/general.

issues.title: Being bounced between two offices
issues.category_name: Bureaucracy: forms, delay and administrative violence
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Acts as or is shielded by an organisation
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Each department is certain the other is responsible. Both are polite. Neither will put it in writing.

details.aspect: The referral is free for them and expensive for you
details.description: Redirecting costs the officer four seconds and costs the citizen a journey, a queue and a day of leave.
details.energy_note: Four seconds for them, a day for you.

details.aspect: Nothing is refused, so nothing is appealable
details.description: Neither office has declined anything. There is no decision in existence to challenge.
details.energy_note: Not refused. Just not anybody's.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the phone transfer
details.description: 'That's not us, that's Assessments.' Assessments: 'No, Assessments only handle existing claims. You want Intake.' Intake: 'Who told you that?' Ninety minutes, four transfers, one disconnection, and a closing line delivered kindly: 'Someone's given you the wrong information, I'm afraid.'
details.energy_note: Ninety minutes, and it is somebody else's fault.

details.aspect: Writing is refused specifically
details.description: Asking for the refusal in writing produces a reason why that is not possible, because a written statement would be capable of being wrong.
details.energy_note: They will say it and will not write it.

issues.title: The rule that was applied to you and not to others
issues.category_name: Bureaucracy: forms, delay and administrative violence
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Decides a case with no obligation to explain or be reviewed
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Selective enforcement of a real rule. The rule exists, it is genuinely being applied, and it is being applied to one person.

details.aspect: Selectivity is invisible from inside one case
details.description: The target sees one enforcement. Proving inconsistency requires data about other cases, which the target has no right to.
details.energy_note: You would need everyone else's file to prove it.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the parking bay
details.description: Every unit on the row has a van in the loading bay. Only his gets the notice. When he raises it: 'I can only act on what I see.' The officer has walked past four other vans to write it.
details.energy_note: Four other vans, and one ticket.

details.aspect: Compliance does not end it
details.description: Correcting the cited breach produces enforcement of a different rule, because the rule was the instrument rather than the objective.
details.energy_note: Fix it and the next rule arrives.

details.aspect: It teaches the target they are being watched
details.description: The lasting effect is not the penalty but the knowledge that somebody is looking specifically at them, which changes how they behave in every unrelated respect.
details.energy_note: Knowing, from now on, that you are the one being watched.

issues.title: Litigation as the weapon
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls money, wages, debt or housing
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable as abuse by a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists and sometimes works
issues.summary: The claim does not need to succeed. It needs to cost more than the defendant has.

details.aspect: Asymmetric cost is the whole strategy
details.description: A party who can absorb legal fees indefinitely can impose them on a party who cannot. Merits become close to irrelevant.
details.energy_note: Winning is not required. Outspending is.

details.aspect: Settlement includes silence
details.description: The resolution routinely requires a non-disclosure term, so the pattern is not visible to the next person it happens to.
details.energy_note: Paid to stop, and to stop saying.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the letter
details.description: 'We note your client's position and look forward to testing it. We anticipate a four-day hearing and will be instructing leading counsel.' There is no allegation in the letter and no offer. It exists to communicate the size of the bill.
details.energy_note: A letter whose only content is the cost of replying.

details.aspect: Legal aid does not cover most of it
details.description: Where representation is unfunded, the choice is self-representation against counsel, or capitulation. Both are described afterwards as the party's own decision.
details.energy_note: Choosing to lose, and it going down as your choice.

issues.title: Reported to the authorities as a tactic
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Acts as or is shielded by an organisation
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: A referral to the police, immigration, a regulator or child services, made in bad faith, which the institution is then obliged to act on.

details.aspect: The institution becomes the instrument
details.description: The reporter takes no action themselves. The state does it, in good faith, at scale, and the reporter's name may never appear.
details.energy_note: He made a phone call. The state did the rest.

details.aspect: Investigation is the punishment
details.description: Even a wholly unfounded referral produces interviews, home visits, disclosure to employers and months of uncertainty. The eventual finding of no concern does not undo any of it.
details.energy_note: Cleared, after nine months of being investigated.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the anonymous concern
details.description: Two weeks after she files for divorce, children's services receive a concern about supervision at the property. The social worker is professional and apologetic and still has to do the visit, and the assessment, and the second visit.
details.energy_note: A phone call, and four months of proving she is a mother.

details.aspect: Malicious reporting is almost never penalised
details.description: Systems are built to encourage reporting, which means bad-faith referrals carry effectively no risk to the reporter.
details.energy_note: Free to do, expensive to survive.

issues.title: Your lawyer works for the person paying
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Knows or controls something about the target
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Company counsel at the grievance meeting, the landlord's solicitor arranging the tenancy, the family lawyer who has acted for his side for twenty years.

details.aspect: Present, professional, and not yours
details.description: The lawyer in the room is correct, courteous and acting for someone else - which the target frequently does not understand until afterwards.
details.energy_note: Everyone in the room had a lawyer except you.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - HR is here to help
details.description: 'This is Marcus, he's just sitting in.' Marcus is employment counsel. He says almost nothing and writes throughout. At the end: 'Just so we're clear, you're not raising a formal grievance today?' She had not realised that was the question being decided.
details.energy_note: A decision taken out of her, without her noticing it was one.

details.aspect: Independent advice costs money she is trying to recover
details.description: Getting her own representation requires funds that are the subject of the dispute.
details.energy_note: Needing a lawyer to recover the money for the lawyer.

issues.title: Work assigned to make you fail
issues.category_name: Workplace power, employment and the manager
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Impossible deadlines, missing information, or nothing to do at all. Both directions appear in the Japanese statutory definition of power harassment, and both produce a documented performance problem.

details.aspect: Both too much and too little are named in law
details.description: Japan's labour ministry panel listed assigning impossible tasks and giving an employee little or no work among the six constituent acts of power harassment. The 2019 statute turns on conduct exceeding what is necessary and appropriate for the business.
details.energy_note: Named in statute, in at least one country.

details.aspect: The record shows underperformance
details.description: The missed deadline is real and documented. The reason it was missed is not documented anywhere, because nobody minutes the withholding of information.
details.energy_note: The failure is on file. The cause is not.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the Friday handover
details.description: 'Client's expecting the model Monday morning.' It is 17:40 on Friday. The data access request he was asked to approve on Tuesday is still sitting unapproved in his queue. On Monday, in front of the team: 'We had a slip on this one. Let's make sure it doesn't repeat.'
details.energy_note: Set up on Friday, corrected in public on Monday.

details.aspect: Being given nothing is harder to report
details.description: An empty calendar is not an incident. The target cannot point to an act, and the isolation is visible to colleagues as evidence that something must be wrong with them.
details.energy_note: Nothing happened to you, for eleven weeks.

details.aspect: It converts into a lawful dismissal
details.description: After two review cycles the file supports a capability process that is, on its own documents, entirely fair.
details.energy_note: Dismissed fairly, on a record that was constructed.

issues.title: Isolation as a management technique
issues.category_name: Workplace power, employment and the manager
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Removed from the mailing list, the standup, the informal channel. Nothing is announced and nothing is denied.

details.aspect: It is a named category, not an impression
details.description: Leymann's inventory groups 45 mobbing actions into five categories, two of which are effects on social contacts and effects on self-expression - colleagues discouraged from speaking to the target, the target excluded from communication.
details.energy_note: Item on a list, catalogued since 1984.

details.aspect: Colleagues comply without deciding to
details.description: Nobody is instructed to exclude. People observe which way the wind is blowing and adjust, which means the target is isolated by people who bear her no ill will.
details.energy_note: Excluded by people who like her.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the meeting that moved
details.description: 'Oh - we shifted it to Thursdays, did nobody say?' Third time. Each time he is surprised, apologetic, and immediately busy. The decisions she needed to influence were taken on Thursday.
details.energy_note: Apologised to, three times, identically.

details.aspect: The target's response is used as the evidence
details.description: Withdrawal, irritability and reduced initiative are predictable effects and are recorded as attitude problems in the person experiencing them.
details.energy_note: The symptoms get written down as the cause.

issues.title: Credit taken, blame distributed
issues.category_name: Workplace power, employment and the manager
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Successes are described in the first person by the manager and failures in the second person about the team.

details.aspect: The manager controls the upward narrative
details.description: Senior people learn what happened from the person who did not do it. The target has no channel to the audience that matters.
details.energy_note: The only version they hear is his.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the steering committee
details.description: 'So what I did was restructure the pipeline - took a while but we got there.' She rebuilt it over five weekends. She is in the room. Correcting him in front of the director would be a career decision, and he is relying on that.
details.energy_note: In the room while it is taken, and unable to speak.

details.aspect: It compounds at review time
details.description: Promotion cases are built from documented attribution. Where the attribution went elsewhere, there is nothing to argue from.
details.energy_note: Nothing on paper to point at, again.

issues.title: The reference as leverage
issues.category_name: Workplace power, employment and the manager
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls access to a thing the target needs
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: The power does not end at resignation. It extends to the next job, and everybody knows it.

details.aspect: It is never stated and never has to be
details.description: Nobody says the reference depends on how you leave. Everyone in professional employment already knows.
details.energy_note: Unsaid, understood, and completely effective.

details.aspect: A neutral reference is a bad reference
details.description: Dates-only is legal, safe and reads to any recruiter as a warning. The sabotage requires no false statement.
details.energy_note: Damaged by strict accuracy.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the exit conversation
details.description: 'I'm glad you're moving on to something that suits you better. And obviously - anyone calls me, I'll be honest with them.' He smiles. It is the word 'honest' and the pause after it.
details.energy_note: One word, and she withdraws the grievance.

details.aspect: It is why most complaints are never filed
details.description: Fear of reprisal is among the largest reasons people do not report misconduct at all, which means the recorded rate of workplace abuse is a measure of willingness to risk a reference.
details.energy_note: The statistics count the brave, not the harmed.

issues.title: Scheduling as punishment
issues.category_name: Workplace power, employment and the manager
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls money, wages, debt or housing
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Shifts, rotas and leave used as a reward and sanction system that appears in no policy document.

details.aspect: Hours are income for hourly workers
details.description: Cutting somebody from forty hours to eighteen is a pay cut administered without any process, and appeals against a rota do not exist.
details.energy_note: A pay cut with no letter and no appeal.

details.aspect: Leave refusal needs no reason
details.description: Declining the day of the wedding, the funeral or the hospital appointment is operational discretion, and repeated refusal is still operational discretion.
details.energy_note: Refused the day that mattered, lawfully.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the rota on the wall
details.description: She asked, once, whether the new starter was being paid more. The following month she has four closing shifts and both weekend days. 'Business needs. It moves around.' It does not move back.
details.energy_note: One question in March, and a different roster from April.

details.aspect: It targets carers specifically
details.description: Unpredictable scheduling is uniquely damaging to anyone with childcare or caring duties, which means the instrument is gendered in effect without being gendered in form.
details.energy_note: Neutral on paper, aimed in practice.

issues.title: What happens after you report
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists and sometimes works
issues.summary: The most filed charge category, for seventeen consecutive years, because it attaches to everything else: the complaint generates a second harm that is often worse than the first.

details.aspect: The scale
details.description: Retaliation charges totalled 42,301 in FY2024 - the most prevalent filing for the seventeenth consecutive year. In FY2021 it appeared in 56.0% of all charges filed.
details.energy_note: More than four in ten charges, every year, for seventeen years.

details.aspect: Why it dominates
details.description: It attaches to every other charge type: a person files a discrimination complaint and is then dismissed, and the dismissal is a separate claim. One dispute generates two harms.
details.energy_note: Complaining creates a second, fresh injury.

details.aspect: The subtle forms are the common ones
details.description: Exclusion from meetings, isolation from colleagues, denial of leave, relocation to a smaller office, unrealistic targets. The legal test is whether it would dissuade a reasonable employee from raising a concern - and small things do.
details.energy_note: Nothing dramatic. Just everything, slightly worse.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the restructure
details.description: Eleven weeks after the grievance, a reorganisation is announced. Her role is not deleted. It is moved under someone two levels below her previous reporting line, and her project is given to the person she complained about. 'This isn't about you. It's been in planning since the spring.'
details.energy_note: A restructure that has been in planning since the spring.

details.aspect: Women report more retaliation than men
details.description: Research finds female whistleblowers experience more retaliation than men, which compounds every gendered category in this file.
details.energy_note: Reporting it is worse for her than for him.

issues.title: Deny, attack, reverse victim and offender
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Freyd's DARVO: the perpetrator denies the behaviour, attacks the person confronting them, and reverses the roles so that the complainant becomes the aggressor.

details.aspect: The three moves
details.description: Deny the conduct. Attack the credibility, motive or stability of the person raising it. Then adopt the victim role and cast the true victim as the offender. Freyd describes it as a particularly pernicious form of denial.
details.energy_note: Denied, discredited, and then accused.
details.notes: Harsey, Zurbriggen & Freyd, first empirical test 2017.

details.aspect: It works on audiences
details.description: The reversal is persuasive to people with no independent information, because distress is legible and the accused performs distress convincingly.
details.energy_note: He is upset, visibly, and she is composed.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the meeting about the complaint
details.description: 'I'm honestly shaken by this. I've supported her career for three years.' He is close to tears. 'I don't know what I've done to deserve it.' By the end of the meeting two people have asked whether he is alright and nobody has asked her anything.
details.energy_note: He cries, and the room reorganises around him.

details.aspect: Institutional DARVO
details.description: The same pattern performed by an organisation - as when a body responds to a complaint by investigating the complainant. Freyd names it a particularly aggressive form of institutional betrayal.
details.energy_note: The institution does it too, with a letterhead.

issues.title: The institution protects itself
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Acts as or is shielded by an organisation
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: Institutional betrayal: the organisation a person depends on fails to prevent or respond to wrongdoing within it, and the failure is a distinct harm from the original act.

details.aspect: It is a second injury with its own literature
details.description: Defined as wrongdoing perpetrated by an institution upon people dependent on it, including failure to respond supportively to wrongdoing committed within it. It harms pragmatically and psychologically, separately from the original event.
details.energy_note: The handling is its own wound.

details.aspect: EXAMPLE - reputation preferred to protection
details.description: Inquiry findings across institutional settings record bodies choosing to preserve the alleged perpetrator's reputation and their own above protecting those in their care, with concerns not escalated, information not shared, and policies in place but not upheld.
details.energy_note: The policy existed. Nobody followed it.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the HR outcome letter
details.description: 'The investigation was unable to substantiate the allegation. We consider the matter closed. We would remind you of your obligations of confidentiality.' Four months. Nobody interviewed the two people she named.
details.energy_note: Unsubstantiated, and the witnesses were never called.

details.aspect: The antidote is named and rarely chosen
details.description: Freyd's institutional courage - transparency, accountability, anonymous victimisation surveys, acting despite short-term cost. It exists as a programme and is adopted by a minority.
details.energy_note: There is a known remedy and it is optional.

issues.title: Hired to be counted
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Acts as or is shielded by an organisation
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: No mechanism exists
issues.summary: Present in the photograph, the panel and the headcount, and absent from the decision.

details.aspect: Visibility without authority
details.description: Put on the external-facing panel, the recruitment brochure and the diversity committee; not on the board, the budget or the hiring decision.
details.energy_note: On every poster, in no meeting that decides anything.

details.aspect: The unpaid second job
details.description: Employee network chairing, mentoring, outreach and 'perspective' - real work, expected, unpaid and uncounted in promotion.
details.time_note: Days per year of uncompensated representation work.
details.energy_note: A second role nobody is paying for.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the panel photo
details.description: 'We need you on the Thursday session - it looks odd otherwise.' She has asked twice to be on the technical review and has not been. She is on the Thursday session.
details.energy_note: Needed for how the room looks, not for what she knows.

details.aspect: Declining confirms a stereotype
details.description: Refusing the representation work reads as not being a team player, and doing it consumes the hours that would produce the promotion.
details.energy_note: Both answers cost her the same thing.

issues.title: The policy that exists to be pointed at
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Acts as or is shielded by an organisation
issues.visibility_note: Constructed so that the target cannot prove it happened
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: A published commitment, a training module and a reporting line, none of which has ever changed an outcome.

details.aspect: The policy is the defence
details.description: Having a policy is what an organisation produces when asked whether it takes something seriously, and having one is legally useful whether or not it operates.
details.energy_note: The document exists. That is its function.

details.aspect: Training measures completion, not conduct
details.description: The metric is the percentage who clicked through the module. Nobody measures whether anything changed.
details.energy_note: Ninety-eight per cent completion, zero per cent difference.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the all-hands
details.description: 'We have zero tolerance. That's not a slogan, it's who we are.' Two rows back sits the person whose third complaint was closed as unsubstantiated last month. He gets a round of applause.
details.energy_note: Zero tolerance, applauded, two rows from the evidence.

details.aspect: It makes the next complaint harder
details.description: Where an organisation has loudly declared itself good on this, the complainant is contradicting the institution's self-image as well as one person's account.
details.energy_note: Now you are also calling the company a liar.

issues.title: This for that
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists and sometimes works
issues.summary: Quid pro quo: a job benefit or condition made contingent on submission. The legal category with the clearest liability rule and the least clear evidence, because it is almost never said in a room with a witness.

details.aspect: The legal shape
details.description: It occurs where employment decisions or treatment are based on submission to or rejection of unwelcome conduct, and typically runs between people at different levels of authority. Where it results in a tangible employment action the employer has no defence to liability.
details.energy_note: The one category where the employer cannot argue it tried.

details.aspect: It is delivered as an offer, never as a threat
details.description: The proposition is framed as opportunity, mentorship or friendliness. Reconstructed afterwards it is unambiguous; heard at the time it is arguable, and the target's uncertainty is part of what it produces.
details.energy_note: Phrased so that objecting is an overreaction.

details.aspect: Refusal is what generates the evidence - against her
details.description: Nothing happens until she declines. Then the shift pattern changes, the project moves, the review is different - each individually explicable, and now she has a motive to allege.
details.energy_note: Nothing was done to her until she said no.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the conference booking
details.description: 'I've put us in the same hotel, it's easier for the sessions.' Then, later, lightly: 'The promotion thing - that's really my call, you know. I like to back people I get on with.' Two sentences, ten minutes apart, neither of which says anything.
details.energy_note: Two harmless sentences that only mean something together.

details.aspect: Hostile environment and quid pro quo overlap
details.description: EEOC guidance is explicit that hostile environment harassment can acquire quid pro quo characteristics where a supervisor abuses authority over employment decisions to make the target endure the conduct - which is how most real cases actually behave.
details.energy_note: The categories are cleaner in law than in a corridor.

issues.title: Severe or pervasive
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists and sometimes works
issues.summary: The hostile environment standard, and the gap it creates: conduct that is plainly wrong and not yet actionable, which the target must absorb until there is enough of it.

details.aspect: Isolated incidents generally do not qualify
details.description: Petty slights, annoyances and isolated incidents are not actionable unless extremely serious. The conduct must be severe or pervasive enough that a reasonable person would find the environment hostile.
details.energy_note: Not yet bad enough, officially.

details.aspect: Which requires the target to keep a tally
details.description: Because the threshold is cumulative, the sensible response is to document everything - dates, words, witnesses - while continuing to work alongside the person being documented.
details.energy_note: Keeping a file on a colleague, for two years, in secret.

details.aspect: It can come from clients and customers too
details.description: Conduct by non-employees under the employer's control counts, and the employer is liable where it knew or should have known and failed to act - which in practice means somebody must report the customer who tips well.
details.energy_note: The regular who is good for business.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the accumulation
details.description: Individually: a comment about her dress in March, a hand on her back in May, a joke in July, being asked to sit next to a client in September because 'he likes you'. Her note-keeping app has eleven entries. Her solicitor says it is probably still not enough.
details.energy_note: Eleven entries, and probably still not enough.

issues.title: Sex for rent, sex for a grade, sex for a shift
issues.power_abuse_note: Cannot happen without a position of power over the target
issues.power_type_note: Controls money, wages, debt or housing
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable as abuse by a bystander
issues.recourse_note: A mechanism exists on paper and does not function
issues.summary: The same transaction outside employment law, where the protections are thinner and the dependency is more total.

details.aspect: It is recognised and named in housing law
details.description: Letting a property, room or accommodation in return for sexual favours is a recognised form of landlord harassment, framed as quid pro quo - housing benefits offered in exchange.
details.energy_note: It has a name in the statute and a shortage behind it.

details.aspect: The power dimension is the point, not desire
details.description: Housing harassment is characterised as an abuse of power that is not always driven by sexual attraction to the tenant, and can instead be discrimination based on sex.
details.energy_note: Not really about wanting her.

details.aspect: Leaving costs more than staying
