issues.summary: Gaslighting: the systematic contradiction of the target's account until she stops trusting her own recollection.

details.aspect: Small, repeated, about verifiable things
details.description: Not grand denials. Whether he said he would be back at six, whether the money was there, whether she was told about the weekend.
details.energy_note: Tiny corrections, daily, about facts.

details.aspect: The target starts documenting, which confirms the accusation
details.description: Keeping notes to check her own memory is exactly the behaviour cited as evidence of her instability.
details.energy_note: Writing it down becomes proof she is unwell.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the dinner
details.description: 'You've got this completely wrong. Ask anyone.' She asks nobody, because asking would be the act of an unstable person, and she has begun to wonder whether she is one.
details.energy_note: She has started to wonder whether she is.

details.aspect: It disables every later account she gives
details.description: By the time she describes any of it to a professional, her own hedging and uncertainty read as unreliability.
details.energy_note: Her uncertainty, produced by him, used against her.

issues.summary: Unpredictable alternation of affection and withdrawal, which produces attachment more reliably than consistent treatment does.

details.aspect: The good periods are the mechanism
details.description: The warmth is real, which is why the account afterwards sounds contradictory and why she defends him.
details.energy_note: The good weeks are not a lie. That is the problem.

details.aspect: Unpredictability does the work
details.description: Not knowing which version arrives makes the target attentive, accommodating and permanently slightly braced.
details.energy_note: Watching his face before she speaks.

details.aspect: There is no incident to report, ever
details.description: Being cold is not an offence. Being warm is not an offence. The pattern has no reportable unit.
details.energy_note: Nothing in it is anything you could tell anyone.

issues.title: Made responsible for his feelings

details.aspect: The causation is asserted and accepted

details.aspect: Prevention becomes her job

details.energy_note: A second job, managing somebody else's temper.

issues.summary: Predictions rather than threats: what the court will decide, what her family will think, what will happen to the children.

details.aspect: Phrased as concern
details.description: 'I'd hate to see you lose them.' Not a threat in any form that can be quoted, and entirely understood.
details.energy_note: Concerned, on the record, for her.

details.aspect: Frequently partly accurate
details.description: Custody proceedings, immigration status and housing really are uncertain, so the prediction is credible because it is nearly true.
details.energy_note: He is not even lying, mostly.

details.aspect: It is the reason the leaving takes seven attempts
details.description: Each attempt is a test of the prediction, and returning is the rational response to a genuine risk.
details.energy_note: She goes back because the risk was real.

issues.summary: Charm, competence and warmth performed publicly, so that the private account has no audience.

details.aspect: Everyone likes him, which is the point
details.description: The public version is not a mask he drops; it is deployed, and it constitutes the evidence base of everyone who would be asked.
details.energy_note: Her whole social world is a character witness.

details.aspect: Her distress is the only visible thing
details.description: She is the one who is tense, who left early, who has been difficult. He is the one being patient with her.
details.energy_note: He is patient, visibly, with her.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the dinner party
details.description: He tops up her glass, asks about her day in front of everyone, and says 'she's been under a lot of pressure' when she is quiet. Two people tell her afterwards how lucky she is.
details.energy_note: Told twice that evening how lucky she is.

issues.summary: Circulated, believed, never stated to her, and impossible to answer because no one has said it to her face.

details.aspect: It is a catalogued mobbing action
details.description: Leymann's inventory includes unfounded rumours among the 45 actions, grouped under effects on personal reputation.
details.energy_note: Item on a forty-year-old list.

details.aspect: Denial spreads it
details.description: Addressing a rumour requires repeating it to people who had not heard it.
details.energy_note: The only defence distributes it further.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the raised eyebrow
details.description: He never says anything. When her name comes up he pauses, then says 'she's very capable' in a particular way, and changes the subject. It takes four months.
details.energy_note: Three words, said properly, and a promotion gone.

issues.summary: Faint praise, omission and the conspicuous absence of endorsement.

details.aspect: Nothing false is ever said
details.description: Every statement is accurate. The sabotage is entirely in what is omitted and how warmly.
details.energy_note: Accurate throughout, and fatal.

details.aspect: It is undetectable to the target
details.description: She is never told why, because the decision-makers themselves cannot articulate more than an impression.
details.energy_note: Nobody can tell her, because nobody quite knows.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the reference call
details.description: 'Was she reliable?' 'She was never a problem.' 'Would you rehire?' A pause. 'That'd depend on the role.' Every word true.
details.energy_note: Two true sentences and a pause.

issues.summary: A reputation constructed from her responses to being badly treated, which then justifies the treatment.

details.aspect: The evidence is her reaction
details.description: Every instance cited is real: she did object, she did email, she was short in that meeting. The cause is absent from every account.
details.energy_note: All of it happened. None of it is why.

details.aspect: It is self-reinforcing
details.description: Once the label exists, further objection confirms it and silence is taken as acknowledgement.
details.energy_note: Both responses feed it.

details.aspect: It travels between employers informally
details.description: Sectors are small, and the characterisation moves by conversation rather than by reference.
details.energy_note: It arrives before her CV does.

issues.summary: Not invited, not informed, not included - with no decision anyone made or would defend.

details.aspect: Nothing is refused
details.description: She is not barred from anything. She simply is not told when it is happening.
details.energy_note: Not excluded. Just never told.

details.aspect: Raising it is the social cost
details.description: Asking why she was not invited is a bigger act than not inviting her was.
details.energy_note: Mentioning it costs more than doing it did.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the photo
details.description: She sees it on someone's feed on Sunday. Eleven of them at dinner. On Monday: 'Oh, it was a last-minute thing.' It was booked on the fourteenth.
details.energy_note: Last minute, booked three weeks earlier.

issues.summary: Made to carry information, blame and negotiation between adults who will not speak to each other.

details.aspect: The child bears the adults' conflict
details.description: Asked what the other said, asked to pass things on, and blamed for the reply.
details.energy_note: Ten years old, and the diplomatic channel.

details.aspect: Loyalty is demanded in both directions
details.description: Every answer is a betrayal of somebody, which is a problem with no correct solution given to a person too young to see that.
details.energy_note: No answer that is not disloyal to one of them.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the car
details.description: 'Did she say anything about the money? You can tell me, I'm not going to be cross.' He is not going to be cross with her. She knows exactly who he is going to be cross with.
details.energy_note: Told he will not be cross with her.

issues.summary: Family membership held out as contingent on compliance about marriage, religion, sexuality, career or contact.

details.aspect: The threat is withdrawal, not violence
details.description: Nobody does anything. They simply stop, and everybody knows the terms on which it would resume.
details.energy_note: Nothing will be done. Everything will stop.

details.aspect: It costs the practical things too
details.description: Childcare, housing, loans, business contacts and care in old age frequently run through the family.
details.energy_note: The whole safety net, contingent.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the wedding invitation
details.description: 'Of course you're invited. Obviously he can't come. You know what your grandmother's like.' Her grandmother has never said anything about it.
details.energy_note: Invited, without him, on her grandmother's behalf.

issues.title: The favoured sibling

issues.power_type_note: Formal rank: can instruct, discipline, dismiss

issues.summary: Differential treatment maintained over decades and denied throughout, which produces adults who cannot describe what happened to them.

details.aspect: Each instance is too small to cite
details.description: Who was believed, whose interests were funded, whose failures were explained away. No single event is anything.
details.energy_note: Forty small decisions a year, for eighteen years.

details.aspect: The other siblings deny it and are sincere
details.description: They experienced a different household and their account is honest, which leaves the target alone with hers.
details.energy_note: Her brother genuinely does not remember it that way.

details.aspect: It surfaces at inheritance
details.description: The pattern becomes legible and enforceable only at the point where it is also final.
details.energy_note: Confirmed, in writing, after the funeral.

issues.title: Care extracted from the daughter
issues.power_abuse_note: Happens between equals too, but is transformed by power
issues.power_type_note: Controls reputation, belonging or standing in a group
issues.visibility_note: Recognisable to the target, arguable to a bystander

issues.summary: The assumption that one specific child - almost always female - will provide elder care, unpaid, with her career treated as the adjustable variable.

details.aspect: It is never decided, only assumed
details.description: No conversation allocates it. It accretes, and by the time it is visible it is established.
details.energy_note: Nobody asked her. It simply became hers.

details.aspect: The cost is measured in her pension
details.description: Reduced hours, declined promotions and years out produce a retirement income gap that arrives thirty years later.
details.energy_note: Paid for in her seventies.

details.aspect: The brother who visits is praised
details.description: Occasional involvement from a sibling attracts gratitude that continuous provision does not.
details.energy_note: He comes at Christmas and everyone says how good he is.

details.aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the family meeting
details.description: 'You're the one with the flexible job.' She is a district nurse. Her brother is a project manager who works from home three days a week.
details.energy_note: Flexible, apparently, unlike his.
